block1_signed_direction_and_contradictio.rule: All AUROCs reported strictly as Signed_AUROC = roc_auc_score(y_true, score_or_gene_z) with Signed_Delta_Z = Mean_Pos_Z - Mean_Neg_Z. Never max(AUROC, 1-AUROC).

key_formula_contradictions_resolved.cohort: GSE165004 (n=72: UIF n=24, RPL n=24 vs Fertile Control n=24)
key_formula_contradictions_resolved.axis: Door 2: S_p4_resist = mean(z(BCL6, SIRT1, KRAS, IL6, IL1B, TNF)) - mean(z(PGR, HAND2, HOXA10, FOXO1))

root_cause_genes.contradiction: CONTRADICTS_FORMULA: KRAS is severely DOWNREGULATED in non-endometriosis UIF/RPL (whereas KRAS is upregulated in endometriosis-linked RIF GSE26787: Signed_AUROC=0.920, dz=+1.40, P=0.0080)
CONTRADICTS_FORMULA: SIRT1 is DOWNREGULATED in idiopathic UIF/RPL (and in GSE111974 RIF: Signed_AUROC=0.326, dz=-0.61, P=0.0402)
MATCHES_FORMULA: Decidual prolactin (PRL) is depleted across UIF, RPL, GSE111974 (Signed_AUROC=0.238, dz=-0.95), and GSE26787 (Signed_AUROC=0.040, dz=-1.29)

key_formula_contradictions_resolved.cohort: GSE95477 (n=20) & GSE164371 (n=21) Oocyte Nuclear Maturation (MII=1 vs GV=0)
key_formula_contradictions_resolved.axis: S_egg_ferro = mean(z(GPX4, SLC7A11, FTH1, GCLC, NFE2L2)) - mean(z(ACSL4, ALOX15, PTGS2, TFRC))

root_cause_genes.contradiction: CONTRADICTS_FORMULA in GV->MII transition: maternal GPX4, FTH1 (AUC=0.010, dz=-1.64), and SLC7A11 (AUC=0.000, dz=-1.71) mRNAs undergo physiological deadenylation during GV-to-MII nuclear maturation, whereas within same-stage mural granulosa cells (GSE286918 NOR vs DOR) S_egg_ferro is positively protective (Signed_AUROC=0.6711, dz=+0.4836, P=0.00153).

CONTRADICTS_FORMULA in isolated MII vs GV oocytes (maternal SIRT3 mRNA is consumed during maturation while TFAM [AUC=1.000, dz=+1.81] surges and CD38 [AUC=0.000, dz=-1.80] drops), whereas in Cumulus/Granulosa cells (GSE107746 & GSE37277) SIRT3 is strongly POSITIVE (Signed_AUROC=0.804 and 0.818, dz=+0.96 and +1.24).

key_formula_contradictions_resolved.cohort: GSE281732 (n=67 Human Spermatozoa RNA-seq: Proven-Fertile n=14 vs Infertile n=53)
key_formula_contradictions_resolved.axis: S_sperm_mot numerator genes CATSPER2, CATSPER4, ATP5F1A

root_cause_genes.contradiction: CONTRADICTS_FORMULA in GSE281732: retained cytoplasmic droplet CATSPER2/CATSPER4 (AUC=0.256, dz=-1.15) mRNA is elevated in infertile spermatozoa, whereas KCNU1/SLO3 (Signed_AUROC=0.8248, dz=+1.24, P=2.08e-4) and COX5B (Signed_AUROC=0.7143, dz=+0.80, P=0.0145) match the formula (+1 in fertile).
